objectives.title: A register of relationships
objectives.statement: Record every standing relationship between agents: each dependency, delegation, mandate, contract and admission, with its owner, its tier and its end or review date.
objectives.metric: Share of observed interactions covered by a recorded relationship
tiers: Relationships between sandbox agents are listed by the builder.
Every relationship a production agent relies on is in the register before it is used.
The register is checked against observed traffic each month, and unrecorded relationships are closed or recorded.
The register is reconciled continuously, and an interaction with no recorded relationship is refused.
objectives.evidence: The relationship register and the latest comparison with observed interactions.

objectives.title: Admissions: who may talk to whom
objectives.statement: Let an agent receive work only from agents its owner has admitted. A stranger asks first, and the owner decides whether to let it in.
objectives.risk: Unwanted or hostile agents reaching an agent
objectives.metric: Messages refused from agents that were not admitted
tiers: Sandbox agents accept messages only from the sandbox.
Each agent accepts messages only from admitted agents, and the admissions list has an owner.
Admissions are decided by the owner, recorded with a reason, and reviewed at each review date.
Admissions from outside the organization need the approval set by the operating model, and are reviewed each quarter.
objectives.evidence: The admissions list with who admitted each agent and when, and the log of refused messages.

objectives.title: Delegation that only narrows
objectives.statement: When one agent passes work to another, pass a signed mandate that says what the receiver may do and for whom. A mandate passed on can only grant less than the one it came from, never more.
objectives.risk: Authority growing as it passes down a chain
objectives.metric: Delegations refused because they would have widened authority
tiers: Sandbox agents may delegate only to sandbox agents.
Each delegated piece of work carries a mandate naming the party it acts for.
Mandates are signed, and every receiver checks that its mandate is no wider than its sender's.
Mandate chains are recorded end to end and sampled by internal audit each quarter.
objectives.evidence: The mandate chain for sampled work, showing each step's scope against the one before it.

objectives.title: Contracts between agents
objectives.statement: Put standing work between agents under a contract that states what will be done, at what price, within what limits and until when.
objectives.risk: Work between agents on terms nobody agreed
objectives.metric: Share of standing relationships with a current contract
tiers: No contract is needed between sandbox agents.
Each standing relationship has written terms, including limits and an end date.
Terms are accepted by the owners on both sides, and usage is checked against them.
Contracts that cross a company boundary are approved under the organization's contracting rules and reviewed before renewal.
objectives.evidence: The contract, its acceptance by both owners and the usage measured against it.

objectives.title: Relationships carry a tier
objectives.statement: Give each relationship its own risk tier, set as the Operating Model describes. A relationship through which one agent can commit money for another raises the tier.
objectives.risk: A low-risk agent used as a path to a high-risk act
objectives.metric: Share of relationships with a tier recorded
tiers: Sandbox relationships are Tier 1.
Each production relationship starts at the higher tier of the two agents.
A relationship that can commit money, sign or make an irreversible change is at least Tier 3.
A Tier 4 relationship has an executive owner and is reviewed each quarter.
objectives.evidence: The tier recorded for each relationship, with the reason when it is higher than either agent's.

objectives.title: Loops between agents
objectives.statement: Detect work that circles between agents, where each agent's own loop limit is never reached, and stop it.
objectives.risk: Two agents keeping each other busy at the owners' expense
tiers: The sandbox limits the depth of any chain.
Each piece of work carries a chain identifier and a depth limit.
Repeated work across a chain is detected, stopped and reported to the owners involved.
Loop reports are reviewed each week, and the relationships involved are reviewed.
objectives.evidence: Chain traces for stopped loops and the depth limits in force.

objectives.title: Cascades contained
objectives.statement: Stop a failure in one agent from spreading to the agents that depend on it, by limiting what each relationship can pass on.
objectives.risk: One failure taking down many agents
objectives.metric: Incidents that spread beyond the first agent
tiers: No requirement applies in a sandbox.
Each relationship has a time limit and a retry limit.
Relationships have circuit breakers, and dependents have tested fallbacks.
Cascade drills that include partners' agents run each year.
objectives.evidence: Relationship limits, circuit breaker records and drill results.

objectives.title: Cost across a chain
objectives.statement: Carry the spending limit and the paying account with work as it passes from agent to agent, so that the total cost of a chain is known and stays within what the first party allowed.
objectives.risk: A chain of agents spending more than anyone approved
objectives.metric: Share of chained work whose total cost was attributed to one account
tiers: The sandbox budget covers every agent in it.
Each delegated piece of work names the account that pays.
The remaining budget travels with the work, and an agent refuses work that would exceed it.
Chain costs are reported per business objective each month.
objectives.evidence: Cost records for sampled chains, showing the budget carried at each step.

objectives.title: How far a stop reaches
objectives.statement: Make a stop reach every piece of work the stopped agent delegated, so that work started for it does not carry on downstream.
objectives.risk: Work continuing after its source has been stopped
objectives.metric: Time for a stop to reach every downstream agent
tiers: Stopping the sandbox stops everything in it.
Stopping an agent revokes the mandates it issued.
Every agent that received delegated work checks for a stop before acting, and the time a stop takes to reach them is measured.
Stop drills across the chain, including partners' agents, run each quarter.
objectives.evidence: Stop records with the time each downstream agent saw the stop, and drill results.

objectives.title: Change impact on dependents
objectives.statement: Before an agent changes, tell the agents and owners that depend on it, and keep to the terms of any contract while they adjust. The Change phase sets the steps.
objectives.risk: A change that breaks agents its owner never heard of
objectives.metric: Dependents told before a change took effect
tiers: No notice is required inside a sandbox.
Dependents in the register are told before release.
Dependents can test against the candidate version before it is promoted.
Changes that affect partners follow the notice terms in their contracts.
objectives.evidence: The notices sent to dependents and any test runs they made against the candidate.

objectives.title: Federation: shared rules at the boundary
objectives.statement: Let each organization govern its own agents by its own policy, and agree the rules that apply where their agents meet: identity, admission, mandates, records and how a stop is honored.
objectives.risk: Gaps where one organization's rules end and another's begin
objectives.metric: Share of cross-company relationships under agreed boundary rules
tiers: Sandbox agents do not cross the organization's boundary.
Cross-company interactions use verified identities and written terms.
Boundary rules are agreed in writing with each partner, and each side can verify the other's identities and mandates.
Boundary rules are reviewed each year with each partner, and each side's assurance evidence is exchanged.
objectives.evidence: The agreed boundary rules with each partner, and the records showing they were applied.

objectives.title: Records that both sides can reconcile
objectives.statement: Keep records of interactions across a company boundary on both sides, in a form that each side can check against the other.
tiers: No requirement applies in a sandbox.
Each side records the interactions it sends and receives.
Records carry shared identifiers and signatures, so the two sides can be compared.
Records are reconciled each month, and differences are resolved under the contract.
objectives.evidence: The records on each side and the reconciliation results.
